title: Retry on Failure
prompt: Write `withRetry(task, retries)`. `task` is a zero-argument function. Call it; if it throws, call it again — up to `retries` additional attempts. RETURN the first successful result. If every attempt fails, rethrow the LAST error.

tests.name: returns immediately when the task succeeds
tests.hint: Return the result inside the try block the moment the call succeeds.

tests.name: retries until success
tests.hint: Loop attempts from 0 to retries inclusive; return early on the first success.

tests.name: rethrows the last error after exhausting retries
tests.hint: Remember the most recent error in a variable and throw it after the loop ends.
